periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with an approximate 2:1 length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial terminus, creating a downward-shifted visual weight from the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuous, smooth semicircular curvature along the superior boundary of the visible pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of bamboo stalks within the oral cavity; significant occlusion of the ventral and posterior regions by dense foliage.
